title: UE radio capability ID availability IE

entities.name: UE radio capability ID availability IE
entities.description: An information element that indicates the availability of a UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: The UE is operating in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: UE supports RACS
entities.description: The UE supports Radio Access Capability Signaling (RACS).

entities.name: UE has applicable UE radio capability ID
entities.description: The UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN.

relations.description: The IE may be included only if the UE is in WB-S1 mode.
The IE may be included only if the UE supports RACS.
The IE may be included only if the UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN.
